bot_hells_a_server_is_flagged_when_it: A server is flagged when it has at least the minimum members and either the bot count or the bot percentage is met. Set a threshold to 0 to turn that check off.
bot_hells_channel_unreachable: The bot cannot see channel {channel}, so join detections will not be posted.
bot_hells_counts_come_from_the_member_ca: Counts come from the member cache, use Recheck for exact numbers on large servers.
bot_hells_error_leave: Failed to leave the selected servers
bot_hells_error_percent_max: The bot percentage cannot be above 100
bot_hells_error_thresholds_invalid: Thresholds must be whole numbers, zero or above
bot_hells_every_new_server_is_checked_af: Every new server is checked after its member list downloads. Flagged ones are reported, and left when this is on.
bot_hells_flagging_both: Flagging servers with at least {min} members and either {count}+ bots or {percent}%+ bots.
bot_hells_flagging_count: Flagging servers with at least {min} members and {count}+ bots.
bot_hells_flagging_none: Flagging servers with at least {min} members and no thresholds set, so nothing is flagged.
bot_hells_flagging_percent: Flagging servers with at least {min} members and {percent}%+ bots.
bot_hells_leave_message_one: Leave {server}? The bot will have to be re-invited to come back.
bot_hells_leave_message_other: Leave {count} servers? The bot will have to be re-invited to come back to any of them.
bot_hells_no_channel_is_set_and_there: No channel is set and there is no join/leave channel to fall back to, so join detections are not posted anywhere.
docker_bot_not_in_container: This bot is not running in a container
docker_compose_pull_description: Fetch the latest images for {project} and rebuild anything built locally. Nothing restarts until you run Up.
docker_compose_up_description: Bring {project} up. Containers whose image or config changed are recreated; the rest are left alone.
docker_compose_update_description: Fetch the latest images for {project}, then bring it up so changed containers are recreated.
docker_containers_and_compose_projects_o: Containers and compose projects on the selected instance's host
docker_error_fleet_update: Could not start the fleet update
docker_error_instance_list: Failed to load the instance list
docker_error_overview: Failed to reach the bot for the Docker overview
docker_error_owners_only: Only bot owners can manage Docker
docker_fleet_subtitle: Every registered instance, the commit it runs, and whether a newer image is published
docker_fleet_updates_available: {count} of {total} instances have a newer build published
docker_grouped_by_compose_project_expand: Grouped by compose project. Expand a project to sample its resource use.
docker_looking_for_socket: Looking for a Docker socket on the host
docker_not_configured: Docker is not configured on this host
docker_other_host: {name} runs on another host; select that instance to read its logs
docker_pull_up_and_build_runs_started: Pull, up and build runs started from here, with their output
docker_self_warning_restart: This is the container the selected bot instance runs in, so the dashboard will lose contact with it until it comes back.
docker_self_warning_stop: This is the container the selected bot instance runs in, so the dashboard will lose contact with it until it is started again from elsewhere.
docker_the_compose_files_are_not_visible: The compose files are not visible from the bot's filesystem
docker_unreachable: The Docker daemon could not be reached
docker_update_all_disabled: The selected instance is not part of a compose fleet

docker_update_bot_hint: Pull the newest image and recreate this bot's container
docker_update_bot_message: Pull {target} and recreate {name}'s container. The bot goes offline for the restart, usually a minute or two.
docker_waiting_for_bot: Waiting for the bot to answer
landing_subtitle: Fleet and host tools for {bot}. Nothing here is scoped to a server.
leave_feedback_ask_owners_why_the_bot_wa: Ask owners why the bot was removed
leave_feedback_channel_unreachable: The bot cannot see channel {channel}, so answers will not be posted.
leave_feedback_no_channel_is_set_and_the: No channel is set and there is no join/leave channel to fall back to, so answers are not posted anywhere.
leave_feedback_no_feedback_matches_the_c: No feedback matches the current filters.
leave_feedback_sent_right_after_the_bot_: Sent right after the bot is removed, once per server every 30 days
logs_error_log_lost: Lost contact with the log; retrying
logs_log_no_match: No lines match the current filters
performance_subtitle: Monitor system resources, method performance, event processing, and module metrics
process_logs_error_load: Failed to load the process list
process_logs_error_owners_only: Only bot owners can read process logs
process_logs_file_was_rotated_showing_th: file was rotated, showing the new tail
